title: RISE Live: catalog words
acceptance: During a reading, words asked in the bar (typed, or heard and asked with Enter) that are nothing but one of RISE's own visuals are answered by the venue with no model call: the visual is shown, the reading is taken up again at once, no request is opened or counted, and the bar says what is shown in plain catalog words for about 4 seconds ("Showing the attractor.", "Making the attractor calmer.").

The recogniser (src/live/catalog-words.js) is pure and draws its vocabulary from the manifests (engine ids, parameter values, cues) plus one small alias table: fractal flame and flame (living flame), pendulum(s) (harmonograph), swarm and filament (attractor trace), rotary (harmonograph pendulums), calmer, brighter, warmer, cooler (cues); a system or palette sets that parameter beside its engine; only the closed filler list may surround them. Anything else, two engines or cues, a value without its engine, a cue the engine on screen does not take, still or oracle, and any input over 120 characters is null and goes to the model unchanged; matching is case-insensitive and folds accents and full-width letters.

Before a reading and after one, every question goes to RISE as before; a reading the runtime cannot show it in (no room for another scene, a cue the engine on screen does not take) sends the words to the model as an interjection.

An engine is shown through the runtime's existing picture path (withPictures, withPictureClips) from the phrase on screen, so the journal, the three frames and perception see it; a cue goes through the running engine's own control.

The reader's choice holds for the rest of the reading: no beat after the passage it was chosen in starts or cues a scene (the model's own, and those of any answer grafted into the reading), and the model's later @visual, @cue, @illustrate and pictures not yet shown are held and journalled as room.held; the next question, a new reading, holds nothing. Looks and paces are not held.

Perception carries the request and the hold to the next request: chose { engine, values?, cue? } and withheld { by: 'rise' }, admitted by admitPerception with bounds (an engine the venue shows by name, at most four of its own values, one of its cues), said as "asked for the attractor (swarm), and it was shown at once" and "RISE’s own scene changes after that were held", and explained in Live's perception guide. The beat grammar, the Current schema, the Worker, the host guide and the Composer card are unchanged.

With the venue's wiring removed the same test fails (note empty).

summary: In RISE Live, a reader who names one of RISE's own visuals during a reading gets it at once, with no model call; RISE's own scene changes after it in that reading are held, and the next request is told.
